title: Claude made my YouTube graphics
summary: I gave Claude one finished YouTube video as a style reference. It made the charts, maps, title cards and comparison graphics for 10 videos in that exact style. Here are the prompts: build a style sheet once, then design graphics for any script.
steps: Pick one finished video whose graphics you love. Export 6 to 10 still frames of its best graphics.
Run Prompt 1 with those frames. Save the style sheet it writes.
For each new video, run Prompt 2 with the script lines that need a graphic.
Build each graphic with Prompt 3 in the tool you use: After Effects, HTML animation or an image tool.

prompts.title: 1. Write my graphics style sheet from frames
prompts.text:
The attached [6 to 10] frames are my graphics style. Write a style sheet I can reuse for every video:
- Typography: font families, weights, sizes relative to frame height, letter spacing
- Palette: hex codes for background, primary, accent, positive and negative colours
- Layout: margins, grid, alignment, where titles and labels sit, safe areas
- Elements: card corner radius, shadows, icon style, chart style (bar, line, map)
- Motion: how things enter and exit, easing, durations, stagger
If you can't tell a value from the frames, say so and give your best guess marked "guess".
Output it as style-sheet.md.

prompts.title: 2. Design graphics for my script
prompts.text:
Use this style sheet: [PASTE style-sheet.md]
For each script line below, design one graphic. Pick the best format for it: stat card, comparison, timeline, map or list.
For each graphic give me:
1. The text on screen (short, max [8] words per line)
2. The layout, using the style sheet values
3. The animation beats with timings in seconds
4. How to build it: After Effects JSX, HTML animation, or an image prompt
Before you finish, check every graphic against the style sheet and fix any font, colour or spacing that drifts.

Script lines:
[PASTE THE SCRIPT LINES THAT NEED A GRAPHIC]

prompts.title: 3. Build one graphic
prompts.text:
Build graphic [NUMBER] from your list as [AN AFTER EFFECTS JSX SCRIPT / AN HTML ANIMATION / A DETAILED IMAGE PROMPT].
Size: [1920x1080 or 1080x1920]. Length: [SECONDS] seconds.
Use only the fonts and hex colours from the style sheet.
Keep all text inside the safe area. Explain in 3 lines how I run or use it.

notes: Keep the style sheet in a file and reuse it, so every video in the series looks the same.
Check numbers and place names on every graphic yourself before it goes out.
